result.summary: Scope test: IN scope (cross-tenant read over tenant-scoped instance tables, new 409 response shaping, DELETE route handler). Diff reviewed: git diff main...HEAD -- lib/ (service_catalog.ex, api/error.ex, routers/admin_services.ex, plus the design md). INV-1 APPLIES, PASS: (a) query_referencing_instances uses Repo.all(query, prefix: schema_name) with schema_name from TenantProvisioning.list_registrations() (server-held registry, no request input); (b) no migration in diff; (c) no tenant_id written. The cross-tenant read is by design on the PLATFORM_ADMIN-only admin surface (design 3.3, 11). INV-2 APPLIES, PASS: the error body comes from the explicit constructor Error.service_referenced_by_active_instances/1 and emits only instance_ids (opaque UUIDs, cap 50) and a truncated boolean; no tenant id, status, count, or business data; matches design D-B (instance ids are the same exposure class as the definition ids already returned). detail is the fixed sentence 'the service is pinned by one or more non-terminal process instances' with no interpolation (verified in diff). INV-3 N/A (no Lua/WASM). INV-4 N/A (no secret resolution; no logging added; grep of service_catalog.ex for Logger/Repo.query: no hits). INV-5 N/A for tenant visibility: admin route, 404 only means unknown service_id, not a tenant-scoped lookup. INV-6 satisfied by this handoff. INV-7 PASS: service_id is bound via the '?' placeholder with ^service_id in the static @service_task_reference_fragment; status list via ^non_terminal_statuses(), limit via ^; schema via prefix option, never concatenated; no Repo.query or raw SQL added. INV-8 PASS: the new tuple has a matching handle_delete clause (no CaseClauseError); changeset error maps to Repo.rollback(:not_found); rescue Ecto.StaleEntryError wraps Repo.transaction so the version-row deletion rolls back; no bare {:ok,_}= matches added. INV-9 N/A (no outbound HTTP). Authz: the admin_services.ex diff only adds a case clause and moduledoc text; the authz_delete "/:service_id", :AdminServicesManage declaration is untouched and authorization.ex is not modified. Transaction semantics: versions deleted first, then entry, in one Repo.transaction, so a failure never leaves a live entry without its archive rows. Guard order: definitions first, then instances (documented). Non-blocking observations: per-tenant LIMIT 51 bounds memory; the instance guard is documented as best-effort against in-flight starts.
